experiment.aggregate_correction_note: Headline aggregate was the simple sum of the three regime-leg sums (-29.65% + -99.58% + -64.53% = -193.76%), which is not a valid cumulative return for an unlevered long-only book (true cumulative cannot go below -100%). Corrected 2026-09-27 by proper chaining over the already-computed per-regime decimals: (1+r1)*(1+r2)*(1+r3)-1 = -99.90%. Original value preserved in aggregate_net above; trade-level data, bootstrap CI, regime legs, stress figure, and FAIL verdict unchanged. stress_net_return (-239.11%) shares the same summation form and is likewise not a compoundable cumulative figure; its failed stress_costs check is unaffected either way.
experiment.scope_caveat: This FAIL applies to the 2-asset (BTC, ETH) variant of cross-sectional-relative-strength only. With only 2 symbols, ranking collapses to a binary switch and is a weak instance of the general cross-sectional class. A future attempt with a broader universe (10+ symbols) is a new, distinct pre-registration requiring its own fresh disjoint holdout — not a forbidden retry of this same hypothesis_id or family.
